summary: Colored sprites inside black hollow square frames move to match destination sprites inside other frames via various mirror/diagonal symmetries, with colors transferred
src: colored sprites s inside black hollow square frames, where anchor is defined as: 1) the sprite's inner pixel, and 2) the black pixel at the minimum corner of the square that overlaps with the sprite's inner pixel
dst: single colored sprites d only inside black hollow square frames
match_cond: symmetry(s.anchor) == d (various mirror and diagonal symmetries)
notes: Definition of anchor point: the relationship between sprite's inner pixel and the black pixel at minimum corner of square containing that pixel
